messages:
ingrid: FYI — EU customer (bank) asked for end-to-end proof that BYOK import into our HSM can be linked to a named operator and immutable audit trail. They want a runbook we can show auditors. Thoughts?

samir: We have ImportKeyMaterial events in cloud-HSM logs but they don't include operator username by default. Need RBAC + session-provenance.

maria: Agree. Proposal: require operator auth via bastion with SSO + ephemeral certs, log session id into cloud-hsm import call metadata, and sign the import event with HSM attestation key.

kevin: Can we add an attestation blob that includes operator id, timestamp, import nonce, and sha256(pubkey) and store in KMS audit bucket? Example: `attestation = sign(hsm_attest_key, json.dumps({operator, ts, nonce, pubkey_sha256}))`

ingrid: Nice. Need legal/controls: retention 7 yrs, digest + chain-of-custody doc, and proof-of-non-repudiation. Also export control concerns.

jess: On RBAC: create a `hsm-importer` role with `require_approval:true` in ticketing system, approval recorded in audit log. Add MFA and break-glass workflow.

samir: Implementation notes: logging: CloudTrail event `ImportKeyMaterial` -> add `requestMetadata.sessionId` populated from bastion. Example filter: `eventName=ImportKeyMaterial AND requestParameters.sessionId:*`

audit-bot: Reminder: we also need to forward those logs to our WORM S3 bucket `s3://redwood-audit/evidence/hsm` with object lock enabled. Retention policy: 7 years.

maria: For KMS integration: store attestation blob as encrypted object using customer CMK when the customer is BYOK; when customer holds CMK we can't read blob - instead we store a hash and ask customer to also store their copy of the attestation. Need onboarding checklist.

kevin: Vuln triage note: if operator workstation is compromised, attestation still binds to session id and bastion cert -> but we should add hardware-auth (YubiKey) to reduce risk.

oncall: Action items: (1) security to draft RBAC role + approval flow (ingrid/samir) (2) eng-infra to add `sessionId` propagation and attestation signing (maria/kevin) (3) compliance to confirm retention/export constraints (jess). ETA: EOW for initial doc? :calendar: 

ingrid: I'll draft runbook and evidence templates (PDF + JSON attestation example). Will ping legal for export controls. Thanks all :thumbsup:
